meaning_en: conflict — A hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war; an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)

meaning_en: consistent — Marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts; in agreement with or reliable

meaning_en: contemporary — Belonging to the present time; characteristic of the present
